article.headline: Nets and Pistons meet Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.description: Detroit Pistons (4-1, first in the Eastern Conference) vs. Brooklyn Nets (0-4, 15th in the Eastern Conference)
article.title: Nets and Pistons meet Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.linkText: Nets and Pistons meet Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.story: Detroit Pistons (4-1, first in the Eastern Conference) vs. Brooklyn Nets (0-4, 15th in the Eastern Conference) New York; Friday, 7:30 p.m. EDT LINE: Pistons -7.5; over/under is 225.5 BOTTOM LINE: The Brooklyn Nets face the Detroit Pistons in an NBA Cup in-season tournament group play matchup. Brooklyn finished 20-62 overall, 14-37 in Eastern Conference play and 12-29 at home during the 2025-26 season. The Nets averaged 105.9 points per game while shooting 44.3% from the field and 34.1% from 3-point range last season. Detroit went 60-22 overall and 39-13 in Eastern Conference play during the 2025-26 season. The Pistons averaged 10.4 steals, 6.4 blocks and 14.2 turnovers per game last season. INJURIES: Nets: Egor Demin: day to day (leg). Pistons: Jalen Duren: out (hamstring), Isaiah Joe: day to day (hip). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
